title: Enterprise Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Hi, I'm Alexa, Senior Cloud Security Engineer at Jane. I'm building our Platform Security function from the ground up, and this is one of the first roles that will shape it. You'll work closely with our Staff Enterprise Security Engineer on the day to day hardening work, and with me on where the function is headed next. I look for people who treat security as a partnership, not a gate, and who want real ownership, and the room to grow into it. This role offers both.

Join Jane as our new Enterprise Security Engineer, where you'll help harden the systems, endpoints, and identities that protect Jane and the sensitive health information our customers trust us with. You'll take on hands-on work across endpoint security, incident response, identity and access, and data protection. If you're energized by reducing real-world attack surface, comfortable owning well-scoped work end to end, and excited about using AI and automation to amplify your impact, we'd love to hear from you.

As a key executor on Jane's enterprise hardening roadmap, you'll work independently on well-scoped initiatives while partnering closely with IT, Infrastructure Engineering, and the rest of Security Engineering. Much of enterprise hardening depends on other teams, so you'll make security feel like partnership rather than an obstacle: bringing people along, delivering findings constructively, and knowing when a call is yours to make versus when to pull in a more senior engineer.

AI is core to how this team works, not a buzzword. We lean on AI and automation to cut toil, sharpen investigations, and move faster, and you'll be encouraged to experiment, build your own workflows, and share what works and what doesn't so the whole team levels up.

What Impact We're Looking For You To Make

  • Own Jane's endpoint hardening baseline, including CIS benchmark adoption, EDR coverage and tuning in CrowdStrike Falcon, and workstation and mobile vulnerability management, coordinating with IT to close findings within SLA.

  • Investigate, contain, and document security incidents and carry a share of the on-call rotation (roughly 5 to 6 weeks a year), escalating at the right time to the right people and keeping runbooks accurate based on real experience.

  • Strengthen identity and access by helping roll out phishing-resistant MFA (FIDO2), Okta device trust and conditional access, and a BYOD program, partnering with IT to keep least-privilege posture healthy across systems.

  • Help stand up data-protection controls (SASE, CASB, DLP, egress filtering, and PHI handling) along with the guardrails that govern internal AI usage across tools, agents, MCP servers, and their access controls.

  • Tune detections and signal-to-noise in our SIEM (Datadog) and build AI-assisted automation that reduces toil, sharing wins and failures openly so the whole team gets better.

What Experience We Think We Need

  • 2 to 4 years in enterprise or infrastructure security, security operations, or incident response, with a track record of taking ownership and growing your skills.

  • Hands-on endpoint and EDR experience (e.g., CrowdStrike Falcon) for triage, investigation, and hardening, plus incident response fundamentals and familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Practical identity and access knowledge across SSO and MFA, Okta or a similar IdP, conditional access, and least-privilege principles.

  • Working SIEM experience investigating alerts and separating signal from noise (Datadog a plus), and a habit of building AI or automation workflows that reduce toil, and sharing what you learn.

  • Strong written communication and genuine collaboration skills that build trust across IT and engineering and make people want to work with you. If you don't meet every qualification but are excited about this role, we'd still love to hear from you.

If you don’t meet every single qualification but are excited about this role, we’d still love to hear from you.

More About Jane

Jane is a founder-led, high-growth SaaS company with a remote-first team working across Canada, the US, and the UK, united by our mission to help the helpers. This role is remote first. We are not hybrid.

We build the products and tools that thousands of clinics rely on every day to run their businesses, care for their patients, and grow their communities. That level of impact means every person at Jane plays an important role in how we show up for our customers. We're all responsible for being deeply connected to their needs, obsessed with improving their experience, and proud of the difference our work makes in their day-to-day lives.

Jane is growing fast, and that growth brings exciting challenges that call for adaptability, resilience, learning agility, and humility. We're proud of what we've built and quick to admit what we don't know yet. We listen, learn, and adjust as we go. More than 70,000 businesses run on Jane which has 250,000+ practitioners interacting with our product on a daily basis and growth is continuing to accelerate.

Our goal isn't just delivery - it's delight. We move quickly, communicate openly, and solve real problems together. If you're energized by ambiguity, motivated by impact, and eager to learn with others, you'll thrive at Jane.

Compensation & Benefits

At Jane, we’re committed to paying fairly, clearly, and above all, paying for growth. This role has an annual salary range of $98,400 to $147,600. While that is a large range, it is intentional. It reflects the full growth journey someone might take in the role, from developing skills early on to becoming highly proficient and ultimately achieving excellence.

Most new hires join at the accomplished stage, which for this role represents an annual salary of $116,900. A starting salary below this typically indicates a candidate with strong potential who is still developing key skills. Salaries above this usually apply to existing team members who have made a significant impact and bring deep Jane-specific knowledge.

We believe in paying for growth. You’ll have regular career development conversations with your manager and your compensation will grow as you gain experience and contribute meaningfully to our mission.

Paying clearly is one of our compensation fundamentals. Watch this short video to learn how our salary bands are set. You’re also encouraged to ask questions about compensation at any point during the interview process.

We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, You can learn more about it here!


Jane takes job scams and candidate fraud seriously. Jane will only contact you from an @jane.app email address. We'll never contact you from a personal email, ask for payment, or request purchases during the hiring process. If something doesn't seem right, please reach out to us at hiring@jane.app before sharing any personal information.
